title: Many at once
intro: Pick pictures from your computer, then make them into ready jigsaws (with the size and difficulty chosen here) or store them as pictures, where the one who plays chooses the pieces and the difficulty. Either way the AI sets the categories and the name of each one.
languageHelp: The language the names are written in. They are translated into the other languages.
chooseHelp: Pick many at once: jpeg, png or webp, up to {{ max }} pictures.
notPictures: {{ count }} files were not jpeg, png or webp pictures and were left out.
tooMany: Only {{ max }} pictures at a time: the rest were left out.
aiFailed: Made, but the AI could not classify it: {{ reason }}
summary: {{ made }} made, {{ classified }} classified by the AI, {{ failed }} failed.
